mode.title: Mode
mode.description: pools = current price, liquidity and trade flow for a network's pools. history = OHLCV candles for pool addresses you name. networks = list every supported network id.
enumTitles: Pools: price, liquidity and trade flow

network.title: Network id
network.description: Which chain to read, e.g. eth, bsc, polygon_pos, base, arbitrum, solana. Run networks mode once to see every valid id.

poolList.title: Which pools (pools mode)
poolList.description: trending = pools with the most current activity. new = recently created pools.

poolAddresses.title: Pool addresses (history mode)
poolAddresses.description: Pool contract addresses to pull candles for. Run pools mode first and copy the poolAddress values. Capped at 5 per run: each pool costs one request and the venue allows only about five before it throttles.

timeframe.title: Candle timeframe (history mode)
timeframe.description: Candle size. The venue rejects any other value, so week and month are not available.

aggregate.title: Aggregate candles (history mode)
aggregate.description: Group candles, e.g. timeframe=minute with aggregate=15 gives 15-minute candles.

candleLimit.title: Candles per pool (history mode)
candleLimit.description: How many candles to request per pool.

minLiquidityUsd.title: Min liquidity (USD, pools mode)
minLiquidityUsd.description: Skip pools holding less than this in reserves.

minVolume24hUsd.title: Min 24h volume (USD, pools mode)
minVolume24hUsd.description: Skip pools trading less than this in the last 24 hours.

requestGapMs.title: Gap between requests (ms)
requestGapMs.description: How long to wait between requests. Note the venue enforces a quota of about five requests per window, so raising this does not buy more requests (measured: the 6th fails at a 1s, 3s and 6s gap alike). Pools and networks modes only make one request and are unaffected.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
